aNovaChatsX: Only the owner reads chats. Writing only from the supernova's account.
aChatRO: Read only. Only the supernova's account can write.
refNote: Check that it is a real person. The decision only affects the inviter's bonus: the account is not blocked and the person is not told.
aRefCanX: Switch off — the link stops working and «Invitations» says they are off. Earned messages stay.
aRefMsgs: Messages with a like: {b} left · for invites {e} · given by hand {g} · spent {s}
aRefUnl: Messages with a like: no limit (star) · spent {s}
aGrantX: Added to the balance; the person gets a bot message. Minus takes some back (never below zero).
aWordsX: On top of the built-in list (nick, tg, telegram, whatsapp, insta, vk, mail, number, phone…). One word per line; a word of 5+ letters is also caught as the start of a longer word.
aIntsNewT: Add an item to the catalog
aIntsBad: Filter refused — the author thinks it was sent
aSugBlocked: Suggesting interests: not allowed (the person does not know)
aWhoNote: An estimate: heavy requests are all written, the rest 1 in 10 (×10). Database rows are the free plan's main limit.
aWhoEmpty: No data yet — recording started with this version.
aBlockUserNote: The profile disappears for everyone, the person gets a message about the block and cannot use the bot. The decision goes to the journal and can be undone.
aChatNote: The bot leaves the chat and never connects to it again, even if added back. Undo with «Unblock».
aNoLoc: Location is never shown to the admin.
aAttNewVisible: Reached the map in 24 h (after a long sign-up): {n}
aLateOnly: Only those who reached the map in 24 h
aJournalNote: Everything you and the moderators did: who opened which profile and which decisions were taken. Kept for 180 days.
bkWhere: All data is in the Cloudflare D1 database (in the EU). Cloudflare keeps its own history of the last days — roll back in GitHub: Actions → «restore database». This button also makes a file you keep.
bkSave: Save the file to this device
bkKey: The file is encrypted with DATA_KEY (the one in GitHub secrets). Without DATA_KEY it cannot be read — keep the key apart from the file.
aFiltersOff: Switch gender and age filters off (test)
aCalib: Send all checklists for tuning the percent
aCalibSent: Sent to the chat with the bot: {p} checklists, {m} mutual like.
aReportSend: Send the report as a file to the chat with the bot
aReportSent: The report was sent to the chat with the bot.
aDiagNote: The report shows the bot from inside: what Telegram thinks of the bot and the chats, every person's steps and who sees whom and why not. No answers, places or Telegram ids. Send it to me as a file.
aPostButton: Post the button in the chat
mIntro1: Reports about profiles from your chats come here. Open a report, look at the profile and answers, decide: dismiss, warn, hide for 7 days or propose a block — a block works after the owner approves it.
mIntro2: The «Profiles» tab has all profiles of your chats with answers. People's location is never shown here.
mIntro3: The owner sees every profile you open and every decision, and can undo decisions.
mTakeNote: «Take» marks the report as yours so that another moderator leaves it.
aUseDb: Database: {r} of 5 M rows read · {w} of 100 000 written
aUseNote: Cloudflare data, a few minutes behind.
aUseOff: The request counter is not set up: add the secret CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN on GitHub (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Secrets) and run the deploy again.
aVisitsNote: At most once in 6 hours per person — for retention. Costs almost nothing.
aRetOff: Recording is off — old data shown
aRetBack1: Came back a day or more later
aRetBack7: Came back a week or more later
aRetNote: Among people who joined after recording started. A visit = opened the app.
txHtmlNote: You can use bold, italic and links …. Write < and & as < and &.
dmTextNote: Comes from the bot as plain text. Your name is not shown.
aStarLaterHint: They opened the bot but are not on the map. The star is given in advance and appears once the profile is filled in.
aStarLightXLater: «{name}» is not on the map yet. The star appears once the profile is filled in — the bot tells them right away.
aAboutHiddenNow: Hidden by you — the person sees it must be changed.
aStarHint: Only profiles on the map. First — those with us longest and with the most mutual like.
aStarLightX: «{name}» gets a message and decides whether to show the star. You can remove it any time.
aStarUncapNote: «Delete caption» — the star stays; the person sees under the field that the caption contained offensive or unacceptable words.
aScrNote: The first visit to each screen, among people who joined in the period. Counted since {date}.
aShapesNote: Only the shape (length, digits, whether there is a link) — never the text itself.
aRetBack30: Came back a month or more later
aStumbleNote: Errors are recorded only while error recording is on.
aStuckNow: Stuck now (a day without a step)
aRemNote: When someone stays on one step for a day, the bot writes one hint for that step. Only 11:00–21:00 Moscow time.
aRemSent: Sent in all {n} · moved on after them {m}
aRemPeriod: In the period: sent {n}, moved on {m}
aMutHow_card: took back the like on the card
aMutHow_gone: the other person deleted their account
aResetPlaceNote: When the place is clearly wrong (a dot in another country): the place is deleted and the person is asked to set it again. Until then neighbours do not see them.
aMapNote: How many people where — by the same zones (~5 km²) people see. A dot inside a zone is placed at random, it is not the person's place. Tap a dot for the nickname and profile. Every view goes to the journal.
aUniNote: People of these chats see each other unless they chose «Only my chat». Strangers do not get in.
aUniOthersNote: You can add one without an application — e.g. after agreeing with its admin in person.
aNoChat: Without connected chats and open space: {n}
aPairsNote: Logged since October 20: earlier changes show only through the current answers. Only you see this.
aPairsNone: No likes in either direction with anyone.
pGone: {date} · a mutual like ended: the other person deleted their account
aVisLine: sees {s} of {r} ready neighbours · opened the bot in their chats: {c}
aAccountNote: Read from Telegram at the moment of viewing, not stored. The view is written to the journal.
aNoPhotos: No photos, or they are hidden by privacy settings.
aSendLink: Send a link to the chat with the bot
aLinkSent: The link was sent to the chat with the bot.
aNoAccount: Telegram returned no account data: the person deleted the account or blocked the bot.
mYou: You are a moderator: {scope} · decided by you: {n}
mOthers: Reports about this profile: {n} from different people
mFrom: From a member of {chat}. Their reports this month: {m}, confirmed: {c} of {d}.
mSame: over 90 % of answers are the same
mBanWait: The block waits for the owner
mBanWaitNote: Nothing happens to the person until it is approved. Choosing another decision withdraws the proposal.
mNote: Every opened profile and every decision goes to the owner's journal. Moderators never see people's location.
aInviteNote: The link works once and is valid for 24 hours. The person sees that you will know their name and @username and taps «Accept» themselves. Then they get a «Moderation» tab.
aModsNote: Moderators see reports and profiles with answers (never location) in their chats. Each decision and each opened profile is in the «Journal»; decisions can be undone.
aNovaContactNoUser: it has no @username — the bot sends the link as a message; whether it opens depends on your privacy settings
aNovaContactQ: Show people with a mutual like with «{nick}» your owner account (name and «Write in Telegram») instead of the supernova's account?
aNovaContactQSelf: Show people with a mutual like the supernova «{nick}»'s own account again?
aRetMut: New mutual likes per active person · 7 / 30 d
aIntsDelX: Only items you added. It disappears for everyone who chose it.
aIntsDelQ2: Delete for sure? This cannot be undone.
aSusX: The person is not told. Others see a quiet mark on the card.
aWhyNote: Each person is counted once, by the first reason. In brackets: how many have this reason at all. No names.
lmNote: Messages people sent with a like. Only the owner sees them; every opening goes to the journal.
bcNote: Arrives from the bot as a private message. Plain text, emoji allowed. Up to 3500 characters.
bcTplQ: Replace the text with the template?
bcAudX_active: People with a finished profile (not blocked).
bcAudX_consent: Everyone who gave consent: with a profile or still registering.
bcAudX_all: Everyone who started the bot, except blocked.
bcQ2: Send for sure? It cannot be undone after sending.
bcLeft: {n} of {all} left. Keep this page open.
bcLater: The connection dropped — the bot sends the rest itself within an hour.
bcE_busy: The previous broadcast is still being sent.
bcTpl:
✨ A big Kinkoverse update!

🌌 The new «Nebula» design — light and dark themes, lighter and calmer.
👆 Swipe through profiles: like on the right, the next one in one move.
⏳ «Not now» for the time you choose — from a day to a year.
🔗 Your own profile link — send it to someone you already talk to.
💞 Easier likes: sort by newest or by match.
⚡️ The app opens faster and uses less data.

Have a look — someone may be waiting for you 💫
bcPhotoX: One picture may go along (JPEG, PNG, WebP). It comes to you in the bot first — so you see how people get it.
bcPhotoCap: The text goes as the photo's caption.
bcPhotoLong: The text is longer than 1024 characters: it comes as a separate message right after the photo.
bcPhotoOk: Photo uploaded — it already came to you in the bot.
bcE_bad_type: A picture is needed: JPEG, PNG or WebP.
bcE_tg_failed: Telegram did not take the picture. Try another one.
bcE_bad_photo: Photo not found — upload it again.
